info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' kAntO lazyati lazyeta Syani vA lazate lazet ' (Slo. 177) iti devaH . kAntiH = icCA .

examples: 'lazapatapada..' (3.2.154) sUtre vfttO apalAzukaM vfzalasaNgatam ityudAharaRaM sTitam. tatrApalazati nAmilazatItyevArTaH sandehAnAskannaH. idaM tu sandihyate kartari tAcCIlye ukaYi vfzalasaNgatamapalAzukamiti kaTaM saNgacCeta. ata evAsmABiH svakftO vyAkaraRacandrodaye'palAzuko vfzalasaNgatamiti pAWa UhitaH.
